bio: Ever the industrious sort, Granvil broke away from traditional Undercity craftsmanship, training with the Magmabloods to learn their metallurgic secrets. On his return home, Granvil's new-found command of molten metal made him Stoneloom's hottest commodity. After multiple attractive offers, Granvil eventually took up the role as the new Royal Smith. His former colleagues are fuming.
